cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.lightning.des: Summons a simple lightning bolt where you're looking.
Summons a single-use bed where you're looking. The bed doesn't change your respawn point. In dimensions where beds are usable, the bed disappears in the morning and can only be placed at night or during thunderstorms.
Can't place a spectral bed that far away!
Can't fit a spectral bed there!
Can't place a spectral bed on there!
In this dimension, spectral beds can only be placed at night or during thunderstorms!
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.force_consume: Consumes the item in your other hand, sometimes even if it is normally not consumable. This can be used to eat items like totem of undyings or potions and to get unpredictable effects.
No item to consume in the other hand
Can't eat the item in the other hand
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.spectral_boat: Summons a spectral boat at the targeted point. The boat has a chest that is shared with your Spectral Donkey's! Despawns if not interacted with for some time.
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.spectral_donk: Summons a spectral donkey, whose inventory is shared with your Spectral Boat's chest! Despawns if not interacted with for some time.
Can't summon a spectral donkey that far away!
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.spectral_slim: Summons a small friendly spectral slime. It follows you from a distance and fights hostile creatures.
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.dmg_buff.desc: Applies a stacking damage buff effect to yourself.
cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.mana_cost_buf: Applies a stacking mana cost buff effect to yourself.
Applies a stacking cantrip buff effect to yourself. The effect is reserved for empowering other cantrips later.
